categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Adds C API endpoints and headers in src/kernel/ allowing external callers to validate blocks without maintaining a complete UTXO set.
categories.rationale: Exposing block validation without requiring an instantiated internal UTXO set significantly expands kernel API completeness for downstream consumers like rust-bitcoinkernel. External applications currently "cannot validate individual blocks without instantiating and maintaining a full internal UTXO set, preventing lightweight or custom UTXO indexing architectures from verifying blocks."

categories.name: mempool

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Carries the Validation label and introduces ChainstateManager::ValidateBlock to invoke ConnectBlock and consensus checks against caller-supplied coins.
categories.rationale: Adds a check-only block validation entry point touching ConnectBlock and ContextualCheckBlock, which validation maintainers must verify against consensus invariants such as assumevalid script verification. It exposes an alternative execution harness rather than modifying the node's standard chainstate validation behavior, making it worthwhile but reasonably deferrable from a core validation perspective.
